audience: security analysts and IT teams who check suspicious links with urlscan.io

useCases.title: Scan a suspicious link in a private sandbox
useCases.text: Check your quota, then submit one URL as a private scan. When the scan finishes, read its verdicts, redirect chain and contacted domains.

useCases.title: See whether a domain was scanned recently
useCases.text: Search past scans of a domain from the last 7 days. Read the titles and IP addresses of the hits, then open one scan for its verdicts.

useCases.title: Find pages on the same hosting network
useCases.text: Search past scans by IP address, network (ASN) or page title. Use the hits to find other sites on the same hosting or with the same title.

useCases.title: Scan a page from a chosen country
useCases.text: List the countries a scan can run from. Submit the scan from one country, for example to see what visitors in that country get.

useCases.title: Check your scan quota before a batch
useCases.text: Read your quota and usage per action, per minute, hour and day. Check it before you submit more scans.
